description: Project mapping of TACO object categories to TrashNet's six class names. This is an approximation, not an official TrashNet conversion or a recycling policy.

policy_notes.foam: Foam cup, Foam food container, and Styrofoam piece are plastic by material.
policy_notes.paper_and_cardboard: Paper cups/straws and cartons/boxes use their predominant material; contamination and possible coatings cannot be inferred from the category.
policy_notes.mixed_packaging: Blister packs, drink cartons, plastified paper bags, crisp packets, and squeezable tubes use trash because the category does not establish a single material.
policy_notes.residual: Food waste, tissues, rope, shoes, and cigarettes use the project's residual trash class.
policy_notes.battery: Battery uses trash only as a six-class taxonomy fallback; this does not describe safe disposal.
policy_notes.unknown: Unlabeled litter is explicitly assigned to residual trash. Its material is unknown, so this introduces label noise. New or misspelled categories cause an error rather than silently falling back.
